تحتضنين (form VIII)
# تَحْتَضِنِينَ (taḥtaḍinīna) /taħ.ta.dˤi.niː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِحْتَضَنَ (iḥtaḍana)
# تُحْتَضَنِينَ (tuḥtaḍanīna) /tuħ.ta.dˤa.niː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَضَنَ (iḥtaḍana)
